summary: Admin: inline manual edit for drafts (title/dek/content) before publishing
description: Drafts tab is read-only (preview + publish/reject/archive). Add an inline editor so the operator can fix LLM output before going live: PUT /api/admin/blog/[id]/edit updates title/dek/content for rows in draft/needs_attention (guarded; editing a needs_attention row with content promotes it to draft + clears error_note). New DraftEditor client island (Edit toggle → form → Save/Cancel → refresh). Add dek to admin-blog POST_COLUMNS/BlogPostRow. Drafts aren't public so no cache bust.
